title: Replication package for Explainability Requirements for Fitness Routine Recommendations: A Field Case Study in Ecuador
description: Anonymized replication package for a requirements-engineering field case study on explainability requirements for a proposed fitness-routine recommendation component in FabroGym. Includes anonymized transcripts, questionnaire data, terminal requirements, traceability, thematic coding, member-checking decisions, processed results and reproducible analysis scripts. Identifiable audiovisual and consent materials are excluded.
